hero.subtitle: FINALLY MADE SIMPLE
hero.description: Ease into Bitcoin with less jargon and no confusion. Bit Terms meets wherever you are, helping you make sense of Bitcoin, one clear definition at a time, with friendly visuals so you understand and remember.

about.title: Welcome to BiT Terms
about.description: Bitcoin can be a lot of “hash this”, “node that”. It’s like it has its own language. It’s almost normal to feel lost or even a little stressed trying to keep up. BitTerms is making bitcoin terms be regular words. We take those complicated Bitcoin terms and translate them into everyday conversation. No stress. Just learn at your own pace.

intro_data.title: CoinJoin
intro_data.description: CoinJoin mixes your Bitcoin with others in one transaction to make it harder to trace, for more privacy.

intro_data.title: Hash
intro_data.description: A hash is a shuffled digital fingerprint used to secure Bitcoin data.

intro_data.title: Node
intro_data.description: A node is a computer that helps run, support, and share information on the Bitcoin network.

contribute.title: How to Contribute
contribute.p1: Want to help make Bitcoin more accessible? You’re in the right place. This section shows you how to get involved with BitTerms. Whether you’re simplifying terms, drawing illustrations, or suggesting improvements, we’ve made it easy to jump in and collaborate with the community.
contribute.p2: Help others learn by adding your own simple explanations, suggesting definitions, sharing feedback, or contributing via images. Every bit helps someone else learn.

process_data.title: Web Interface
process_data.description: For Non-Technical Users, visit BitTerms, navigate to the 'Suggest a Term' page, fill out the form with your contribution details, and submit. We'll review and add it to the platform.

process_data.title: GitHub Issue
process_data.description: For Technical Contributors, create a new GitHub issue using our template with required fields (term name, technical definition) and optional fields (simple definition, illustration, audio file, author name).

process_data.title: Ensure Quality Standards
process_data.description: Make sure your definitions are accurate and up-to-date, use clear and concise language, include sources for specific facts, and keep illustrations clean and easy to understand.

process_data.title: Be Respectful and Collaborative
process_data.description: BitTerms is a community effort. Share feedback kindly, stay open to suggestions, respect other contributors, and focus on making Bitcoin clearer for everyone.

support.title: Helping people understand Bitcoin One word at a Time!
support.description: BitTerms is not just a list of words; it's a continuous project for sharing knowledge and making Bitcoin accessible to everyone. Here's how we do it.

support_data.title: Terms Simplification
support_data.description: We turn complex Bitcoin lingo into plain, everyday language. If you can explain it to a friend over coffee, to a 9 year old, or to a grandpa, you’ll find it here.

support_data.title: Illustrations
support_data.description: We pair clear definitions with simple illustrations to make learning intuitive. Because sometimes, a sketch does what a paragraph can’t; it bridges the gap between confusion and clarity.

support_data.title: Open Source
support_data.description: Add your own plain-language definitions, suggest edits, share feedback, or upload visuals. Every contribution makes Bitcoin clearer for someone else. Bit by bit, together, we build understanding.

guides.label: Write for Everyone
guides.description: Use everyday, beginner-friendly language. Avoid jargon or overly technical terms unless absolutely necessary, and explain them if used.

guides.label: Keep it Short
guides.description: Aim for 1–2 clear sentences per simplified definition. Imagine you’re explaining it to a curious 12-year-old.

guides.label: No Dashes or Complex Formatting
guides.description: Avoid using long dashes or overly structured formats, keep it conversational and human.

guides.label: Stay True to its Meaning
guides.description: While simplifying, don’t distort the original meaning. Cross-check with the standard definition to ensure accuracy.

guides.label: Use the Stickman Style
guides.description: All illustrations should follow the playful, minimalist stickman style we've adopted, simple shapes, clear actions, and expressive gestures.

guides.label: Match the Definition
guides.description: Illustrations should visually represent the simplified definition of the term, helping users understand it at a glance.

guides.label: White Background Only
guides.description: Keep all illustrations on a plain white background to maintain visual consistency across the project.

guides.label: Use Vector Format
guides.description: Submit your illustrations as scalable vector graphics (SVG or high-res PNG) to ensure they remain sharp and adaptable.
